competitors.why: Enterprise data and AI platform sold to the same large commercial buyers as Foundry/AIP (data layer plus AI apps); competes for the commercial data-platform budget. PLTR 10-K names no company, only 'large enterprise software companies'; this is my classification.

competitors.name: C3.ai, Inc.
competitors.why: Enterprise AI application software vendor selling AI apps to large commercial and government/defense buyers, same buyer set as AIP; small-scale comparator.

competitors.name: Booz Allen Hamilton Holding Corporation
competitors.why: Government contractor and system integrator (the 10-K names 'government contractors and system integrators' as competitors) selling analytics/AI mission software and services to the same federal agencies as Gotham/Apollo.

bottlenecks.reading: What PLTR supplies is the ability to deploy AI on a customer's own operational data inside hard-to-execute institutions (AIP bootcamps, embedded engineers); the scarce part is working production deployment, which the 10-K says high installation costs, failure risk and long sales cycles make hard for smaller vendors. Evidence of paid adoption: U.S. commercial revenue +149% y/y to $764M and U.S. commercial remaining deal value $6.238B (+124% y/y) in Q2 2026 (company release).

U.S. government is the second pillar: revenue from U.S. government customers was $1.9B in FY2025 vs $1.2B in 2024 and $809M in Q2 2026 (+90% y/y); the 10-K says PLTR intends to capture a greater share of federal software spend.
Duration of the shortage and who adds capacity (Databricks, hyperscaler AI platforms, integrators) is not evidenced from sources retrieved in this lane; treat as an open question.

market_direction.reading: Buyers are spending more, on PLTR's own paid numbers: U.S. commercial revenue $764M in Q2 2026 (+149% y/y), U.S. commercial TCV $2.132B (+153% y/y), total TCV $3.373B, total remaining deal value $13.1B (+83% y/y) and U.S. government revenue $809M (+90% y/y). Management says Department of War TTM revenue is under 25 bp of the Pentagon budget (a statement, not a market study). FY2026 revenue guide was raised from $7.656B to $8.154B midpoint (+82% y/y). No attributed third-party market-size study was retrieved: the size of the market is a gap; the direction is read from buyers' paid commitments only.

bottleneck_potential.reading: PLTR supplies working production deployment of AI on a customer's own operational data inside hard institutions (10-K: high installation cost, failure risk and long sales cycles). Evidence it is scarce: deals of $10M+ closed rose to 73 in Q2 2026 and average revenue per top-20 customer rose to $124M TTM from $75M (+67%), with NDR 157%. The 10-K also says the main competitor is customers' own in-house development, so the scarcity can be built around. How long it lasts and who adds capacity (Databricks, hyperscaler AI platforms, integrators) is not evidenced: duration is a hypothesis, not a driver.

share_trajectory.reading: On reported revenue growth PLTR is gaining against all three named comparators: PLTR FY2025 +56.2% ($4.475B) vs Snowflake +29.2% (FY Jan-2026, $4.684B), C3.ai -35.7% (FY Apr-2026, $250M) and Booz Allen -6.4% (FY Mar-2026, $11.2B); in Q2 2026 PLTR grew 93% y/y ($1.935B). PLTR's revenue has now roughly matched Snowflake's annual base and is 18x C3.ai's. Fiscal years and segments are not like for like and no share of a defined market is computed.

competitive_position.reading: Stronger than each named competitor on growth and economics: GAAP operating margin 31.6% and gross margin 82.4% in FY2025 vs Snowflake operating margin -30.6% and gross margin 67.2%, C3.ai operating margin -199% and gross margin 30.9%, Booz Allen operating margin 9.2% with shrinking revenue. Adjusted gross margin 86% and segment contribution margins 71% government / 78% commercial in Q2 2026. Weaker on scale against Booz Allen in federal services (BAH $11.2B revenue) and unmeasured against private Databricks and hyperscaler platforms (gap).

threats.reading: Evidenced threats: (1) in-sourcing, which the 10-K calls the fundamental competition (customers' own development, consultants, open source); (2) U.S. government budget and contracting: government was 52% of H1 2026 revenue, U.S. customers 80%, most government contracts are terminable for convenience and options run at most a year ahead; (3) intense competition from large software firms, integrators and frontier AI labs, plus dependence on third-party cloud ($5.6B hosting commitment to 2036) and models; (4) regulatory and reputational scrutiny, including European data-sovereignty press and a Pentagon sole-source memo questioned in the press (press items unconfirmed at source, unsized). No new entrant is evidenced with numbers.

bear.event_he: הממשלה האמריקאית (כמחצית מההכנסות) מאטה או מבטלת חוזים: רוב החוזים ניתנים לביטול, והאופציות בצבר העסקאות אינן מחייבות.
שולי הרווח של רבעון השיא (47%) לא מחזיקים: עליית הוצאות עונתית ברבעון השלישי ותחרות מצד מעבדות AI ופלטפורמות ענן.
התחייבות ענן של 5.6 מיליארד דולר עד 2036 הופכת לעלות קבועה כבדה אם הצמיחה נעצרת.
חשש באירופה מגישת ממשל ארה"ב לנתונים פוגע בחוזים מחוץ לארה"ב (כ-20% מההכנסות).

base.event_he: פלנטיר עוברת שוב את תחזית 2026 (8.15 מיליארד דולר), כמו בכל 8 התקופות האחרונות.
צבר העסקאות (13.1 מיליארד דולר, +83%) והחוזים החדשים בארה"ב הופכים להכנסות ב-2027, והצמיחה מאטה בהדרגה לכ-45%.
לקוחות קיימים מגדילים הוצאה (שימור הכנסות נטו 157%) ומספר הלקוחות המסחריים בארה"ב ממשיך לגדול.

bull.event_he: המסחרי בארה"ב ממשיך לצמוח מעל 100% בשנה ב-2027, כפי שמרמז קצב החוזים החדשים (+153%).
הממשלה מרחיבה את Maven ותוכניות ההגנה; ההכנסה מהפנטגון עדיין פחות מרבע אחוז מתקציבו.
המינוף התפעולי נמשך (69% רווח שולי על כל דולר הכנסה נוסף) ושולי הרווח עולים ל-50%.

current_year_revenue.reason: FY2026 guide 8.150-8.158B raised on 2026-08-03; the company beat its revenue guide in 8 of 8 recorded periods (ratio 1.082), so the ratio is applied to the Q3 guide (the only guided unreported item); the implied Q4 (about 2.42B) is left unadjusted, which keeps the estimate on the cautious side.

growth_anchor.reason: No FY2027 guidance. The FY2026 guide implies Q4 2026 revenue of about 2.42B (8.154B less Q1 1.633B, Q2 1.935B, Q3 guide 2.162B), so the Q4 run rate alone is about 9.7B, +16-19% over FY2026 with zero further sequential growth. Sequential growth was 16% (Q1) and 19% (Q2); base = sequential growth slowing to about 8% a quarter in 2027 (about 12B, +45%), backed by total remaining deal value 13.1B (+83% y/y), U.S. commercial TCV 2.13B in Q2 (+153%) and NDR 157%. Bear = sequential growth falls to about 2-3% a quarter (government timing, deal slippage): about +25%, close to the exit run rate. Bull = sequential growth near 12% a quarter, as in the U.S. commercial TCV trend: about +65%. Attributed consensus (12.36B, +50%, not citable until 2026-11-03) is a cross-check only.

mature_margin.reason: GAAP operating margin after SBC: FY2025 31.6%, TTM to Q2 2026 about 42.8%, Q2 2026 47.1%; the FY2026 guide (adjusted operating income 4.893B on 8.154B revenue, about 60%) less SBC of about 13.5% implies about 46%. Base 45% = the guided FY2026 level held (not the record quarter). Bear 36% = margins fall back toward FY2025 as competition (frontier AI labs, hyperscaler platforms) and the 5.6B cloud commitment press costs. Bull 50% = incremental operating margin (69% y/y in Q2 2026) keeps lifting the average.

sbc_pct.reason: SBC / revenue fell from 24% (FY2024) to 15.3% (FY2025) and 13.7% (Q2 2026; TTM about 13.6%). Base holds about today's level; bear returns to the FY2025 level (retention grants in a hot AI labour market); bull continues the decline as revenue outgrows grants.

bear.reason_he: בתרחיש הדובי הצמיחה דורשת יותר הון: יתרת הלקוחות כבר גדלה מהר מההכנסות (פי 2.9 מול פי 2.0 בין 2023 ל־2025), ואם חוזים ממשלתיים מתעכבים או נחקרים ונדרשים יותר מהנדסים בשטח כדי לסגור עסקאות מסחריות, התשואה על כל דולר הון נוסף יורדת לכ־50%. זה עדיין עסק תוכנה רווחי, אבל מכפיל גבוה לא מוצדק כשהצמיחה נחלשת.

base.reason_he: ההון התפעולי של פלנטיר (הון עצמי פחות מזומן והשקעות קצרות, בלי חוב, מוניטין זניח) עלה רק בכ־400 מיליון דולר בין 2023 ל־2025 בזמן שהרווח התפעולי עלה ביותר ממיליארד ומאתיים מיליון, כלומר תשואה על ההון הנוסף של מעל 200%; ההשקעות ההוניות זניחות והלקוחות משלמים מראש (התחייבויות חוזיות 1.1 מיליארד). לקחנו בשמרנות 100% כי יתרת הלקוחות גדלה מהר ופיצוי במניות הוא עלות אמיתית שכבר נמצאת ברווח. תשואה כזו מצדיקה מכפיל גבוה כל עוד הצמיחה נמשכת.

bull.reason_he: בתרחיש השורי הלקוחות הקיימים ממשיכים להגדיל את ההוצאה (שימור הכנסות נטו 157%, הכנסה ממוצעת ל־20 הלקוחות הגדולים עלתה מ־75 ל־124 מיליון דולר בשנה) והצמיחה ממשיכה להגיע כמעט בלי הון: התשואה על ההון הנוסף נשארת ברמה שהחברה כבר הראתה (מעל 200% בין 2023 ל־2025), חסומה בתקרה של 150%. כך המכפיל נשאר גבוה יותר לאורך יותר שנים.

own_history.years: 2023-2024 (December close / next fiscal year's reported GAAP diluted EPS)

key_risk.reading_he: המחיר (כ-157 פעמים הרווח של 12 החודשים האחרונים) כבר מניח שנים של צמיחה מהירה; כמחצית מההכנסות מממשלות בחוזים שניתנים לביטול, ו-81% מההכנסות מארה"ב, כך שהאטה בתקציבים או בהוצאות AI תפגע מהר במכפיל.

moat.note: Evidenced source: embedded deployment and expansion inside existing customers (NDR 157%, top-20 average $124M TTM, +67%), with 82% gross margin and 32% GAAP operating margin vs Snowflake (-31% op margin) and C3.ai (-199%). Duration is not proven: the 10-K says in-house builds are the main alternative.

switching_costs.note: 10-K: high installation costs and deep integration in customer operations; customers keep expanding (NDR 157%); RDV $13.1B and RPO $4.9B lock in multi-year work. Caveat: most government contracts are terminable for convenience.

pricing_power.note: Gross margin rose from 80.6% (FY2023) to 82.4% (FY2025) and adjusted 86% in Q2 2026 while volume grew; no direct price-increase disclosure, so price versus volume is not separated.

retention.note: Net dollar retention 157% in Q2 2026 (+700 bp q/q); U.S. commercial customers 653 (+35% y/y). Logo churn is not disclosed.

customer_concentration.note: No customer above 10%; top three 16% of H1 2026 revenue (17% a year earlier); but government is 52% and U.S. customers 80% of revenue, a concentration in one buyer country and its budget.

competition.note: PLTR +56% FY2025 vs Snowflake +29%, C3.ai -36%, Booz Allen -6%; strongest of the named set. Databricks and hyperscaler platforms are unmeasured (gap).

substitutes.note: 10-K names customers' in-house development, consultants and open source as the fundamental competition, and frontier AI labs as competitors; the current growth shows PLTR winning, but the substitute is always available.

management.note: Delivery vs promises: revenue beat the guided midpoint in all 8 recorded periods (mean actual/guide 1.08; Q2 2026 $1.935B vs $1.799B midpoint) and the FY2026 guide was raised from $7.656B to $8.154B. CEO growth aspirations on the call are statements, not guidance.

capital_allocation.note: No debt and $7.2B cash plus short-term investments at FY2025; operating income $1.41B on equity $7.39B that is almost all cash, so operating invested capital is near zero (ROIC not meaningful, very high). Against that, SBC $684M (15% of FY2025 revenue) vs buybacks only $75M; diluted shares rose from 2.298B (FY2023) to 2.565B (FY2025), about 5.7% a year: dilution of current holders is real.

governance.note: 10-K risk factors: founders hold concentrated voting power through the multi-class structure, limiting outside holders' influence; SBC-driven dilution (diluted 2.569B vs basic 2.400B shares in Q2 2026).

regulation.note: Export controls and sanctions apply; AI-related regulatory and reputational scrutiny; European data-sovereignty concerns reported in press (unconfirmed at source, unsized, non-US is about 20% of revenue). No quantified regulatory loss.

technology_ai.note: Paid AIP adoption in the company's own numbers (U.S. commercial +149% y/y, U.S. commercial TCV +153%, 73 deals of $10M+ in Q2 2026), not partner logos; depends on third-party models and cloud (10-K).

geopolitics.note: Western defense spending is a tailwind (UK MoD enterprise deal GBP 240.6M, press); no China revenue by choice; non-US revenue grew more slowly (rest of world 19% of Q2 2026 vs 27% a year earlier) and faces European sovereignty pushback (hypothesis, unsized).

cyclical.reason: Revenue grew every year FY2020-FY2025 (17%-56%) with no down year and operating margin rose steadily; demand is software adoption (AIP) funded by government programmes and enterprise budgets, not a price cycle.
